synonyms: The Girl Who Can Clearly Say "I Love You" Is Unbeatable
synopsis: There's always just one surefire way to win in a romantic comedy—simply saying "I like you!" The girls who have feelings for high school boy Izumi spent their days unable to take that first step forward. [The School Idol Who Only Wants to Be Pampered When It's Just the Two of Them] Amane Amasaki. [Even Though I Was Disowned, My Former Fiancé Just Won't Leave Me Alone!] Hakua Shiragiku. [The Angel of the Academy... But the Devil Next to Her Is Surprisingly Easy] Haru Kasuga. However, transferring into their class is Nanao Nanase, a seemingly ordinary girl who is actually a natural-born main heroine! Nano starts her fierce assault on Izumi with her shameless and straightforward approach. "Izumi-kun, I like you. Please go out with me." "Here, say 'ahh'~♪" "Izumi-kun, you're the one who made me into this kind of girl, you know?" In a panic, Amane and the others can't help but spring into action—"This girl... She actually did it!?" (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synonyms: When I Tried to Conquer the School Princesses, It Turned Into Romantic Mayhem
synopsis: “Make me a princess!” One day, Yuma Kanbara finds himself in a tough spot, when his younger sister, Ayane, blackmails him with a certain cringe-worthy secret from his past. Her demand? To secure her a spot among the “Hime 6,” the prestigious titles awarded only to the top six candidates in Himegasaki Academy’s famous general election. Determined to claim the throne, Ayane leverages Yuma's weakness to make him “conquer” her rival princess candidates to clear the path to her victory. But winning over the school’s most captivating beauties is no easy task, and Yuuma struggles at every turn… Worse still, as he gets involved with the girls, he finds himself getting tangled up in the increasingly complicated romantic lives of the princesses themselves! With egos laid bare and love and scheming colliding at full force, the most chaotic romantic comedy ever is about to begin! (Source: SB Creative, translated)

synopsis: Kaedetsuki, a high school student in the light music club, feels frustrated by his inability to fit in with his surroundings and his lack of clear goals. One day, while attending his favorite band's live performance for the first time, he meets his sister's friend, Asuka. While attending a vocational school to become a nursery school teacher, Asuka has been unable to give up on her once passionate pursuit of music. Kaedetsuki and Asuka feel suffocated by their suffocating daily lives. The two hit it off and start a band, but various obstacles stand in their way... Friends, family, adults, people they love. People try to understand others. They want others to understand them. In the process, they discover a little bit of themselves they can like. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
